text:
sam wu: Quick update — ran a hybrid-KV quant experiment (FP8 keys + INT8 values) against the 13B shadow cluster. Putting raw notes here.

benchbot: Automated run summary (2026-03-20 15:04 UTC)
```
cmd: bench-run --model redwood-13b-shadow --kv-quant=keys:fp8,vals:int8 --batch=8 --prefill=on --trace=prod-sample-1h
mem: 44% reduction in KV store size (vs full-fp16)
throughput: -3% sustained tokens/sec (batch=8)
latency (warm): p50 +2ms, p95 +7ms, p99 +6ms
latency (cold): p50 +12ms, p95 +25ms, p99 +18ms
accuracy (SQuAD em): -0.6% abs
rerank MRR: -0.8% abs
fallbacks: 0.4% (policy: p99>120ms)
notes: no hard OOMs, tail increases localized to cold prefill paths
```

maria gonzalez: EM -0.6% is bigger than I expected for keys only, any per-difficulty breakdown?

sam wu: breakdown: short-context Qs ~ -0.2% EM, long-context (>1024 tokens) ~ -1.2% EM. Hypothesis is noisy key similarity causing worse nearest-prefix matches for long contexts.

raj patel: p99 cold +18ms — is that from quant dequant overhead, or extra KV cache misses?

sam wu: Stack traces + perf counters point at two components: extra dequant step on hot path (+~4ms) and a measurable increase in cache lookup collisions / softmatch resolution (+~10-12ms) when keys are lower precision. We instrumented KV lookup histogram and saw increased retries.

jen choi: Did you try selective-layer keys quant (only top layers or only bottom layers)?

sam wu: Yes. Quick table:
```
- all-layers keys FP8: mem -44%, SQuAD -0.6% EM, warm p99 +6ms
- top6-layers keys FP8: mem -30%, SQuAD -0.25% EM, warm p99 +3ms
- layers>8 FP8: mem -36%, SQuAD -0.2% EM, warm p99 +4ms
```
Selective quant of higher layers seems promising — most of the accuracy delta concentrated in very long prefix matches where lower layers matter less.

maria gonzalez: Any difference between AWQ/GPTQ profiles vs straight FP8 encode?

sam wu: We tried AWQ on keys (layerwise mixed) — it reduced mem less (approx -38%) but improved EM by ~0.15% vs naive FP8. GPTQ variants had similar gains but increased compile time and slightly higher p95 latency. AWQ's noise shaping looks beneficial for rank-sensitive tasks.

raj patel: What about end-to-end cost impact with fallbacks? Any uplift?

sam wu: With fallback policy enabled (route requests hitting latency threshold to fp16 nodes) observed cost delta ~+2% for the fleet in the shadow window, because fallback rate is low (~0.4%) but those routed requests are expensive. Net cost still down due to memory saving enabling higher packing.

jen choi: Any observed behavioral regressions (hallucinations, token drops) in generation?

sam wu: Not classic hallucinations, but saw occasional unstable token probabilities around entity names in long contexts — manifests as different top-3 tokens in sampling runs. Repro script: run 100 deterministic continuations on prod trace IDs A..Z — logged 12 samples with token divergence at position ~350-420.

benchbot: Full microtrace attached to internal bucket (link suppressed). Key excerpts:
```
- cache_lookup(layer=10,key_hash=0x3a2f): 3 retries, dequant time 0.9ms
- prefill_kv_loop: extra memcpy 1.8ms when keys are packed into 8-bit words
- total extra per-prefill: ~12ms on average
```

maria gonzalez: Thoughts on mitigations?

sam wu: Plan:
- Run longer (24h) shadow traffic with selective-layer FP8 keys (layers>8) + AWQ tuning
- Try stochastic rounding in FP8 encode path to reduce bias
- Add a quick cache-candidate verification step: store a 16-bit fingerprint alongside 8-bit key to avoid false-positive matches (cheap check before full-dequant compare)
- Re-evaluate fallback thresholds (tighten to keep user impact low)

jen choi: Would the 16-bit fingerprint negate memory wins much?

sam wu: Adding 16-bit fingerprint to each key increases KV memory by ~12% of the KV store, so net mem still ~+30% reduction vs fp16, tradeoff seems fine. We'll simulate.

raj patel: cc @eng-sre — if we enable hybrid for a small canary, what ops signal should we watch?

sam wu: Watch p99 overall and per-route, fallback rate, cache hit ratio, and the new 'kv-retry' counter I added. Also monitor user-facing evals (QA EM, rerank MRR) on the canary slice.

maria gonzalez: ok thanks. Please drop the 24h job config when you kick it off. :thumbsup:

sam wu: Will do. Kicking off perf + AWQ sweep tonight and posting results in this thread tomorrow. :coffee:
